label: Bible Study
prompt: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be _____ unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
verse: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
note: Paul's job description for the Lord's servant — gentle, teachable, patient.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For thou wilt light my _____: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
verse: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
note: God lights my candle — and even a small flame changes a dark room.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make _____ of skins, and clothed them.
verse: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
note: Before sending them out, God himself made Adam and Eve coats of skins — an upgrade from fig-leaf aprons.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And seek the peace of the _____ whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
verse: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
note: Jeremiah's letter to the exiles: pray for Babylon, because your welfare is tied up with hers.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the LORD said, I have _____ according to thy word:
verse: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
note: Moses interceded after the spies' bad report, and God answered in seven words: 'I have pardoned according to thy word.'
